paragraphs: It is a sunny morning. Dad, Tom, Ben, and Pip drive to a village. "The weather is great!" says Dad. "Today we can see the waterfall." Pip puts his head out of the window. He is very happy. He looks at the green trees and the small houses. The people in the village smile and wave.

Then the wind comes. It is very windy! Tom's yellow hat flies up. "My hat!" shouts Tom. "Where is it?" asks Ben. The hat goes up and down in the sky. Pip runs after it. The hat falls on the grass near the water. "Be careful, Pip!" says Ben. Pip jumps and catches the hat. He brings it to Tom.

"Good dog!" says Tom. Now there is a big gray cloud in the sky. The rain comes, and the boys run under a tree. Pip is wet, and he shakes his body. Then they see the waterfall. It is tall and white. The sun comes back. "Look!" says Ben. "A rainbow above the waterfall!" Dad takes a photo of the boys, Pip, and the rainbow. Tom puts on his hat and holds it with two hands. "Sunny, windy, and wet," he says. "What a day!"
text.summary: Tom, Ben, and Pip go to a village with Dad to see a waterfall. The weather changes, and Pip saves Tom's hat.
